title: Chapter 170: Attacking The Underworld
content:
Chapter 170: Attacking The Underworld

The restoration and construction of Guangfu City is mainly the responsibility of the Alliance, and the Zerg army is mainly responsible for strengthening the security control within the Alliance territory.

The Zerg's puppies rely on various Alliance territories and are spread throughout the region. They actually control a large area of territory, and any disturbance cannot escape the eyes of the Zerg.

Yesterday, the Zerg occupied many strongholds of the Evil God camp. Relying on Guangfu City and these strongholds, the Zerg continued to strengthen the actual control of large areas in the east and expand the actual controlled territory to the east.

With the Zerg puppies distributed everywhere, the various territories of the Alliance no longer need to worry about the safety of their own territories. The troops of the Alliance territory are all out, and they don’t have to worry about the safety of the rear. They can fight and participate in construction in the front with peace of mind.

In addition to the Zerg puppies who went out to assist the Naga tribe and the Zerg puppies stationed outside, the real main combat power of the Zerg has returned to the Zerg territory.

Letting the Zerg's combat power idle is a great waste.

Adhering to this idea, in the absence of large-scale enemies around, Wu Qing cannot let the Zerg's high-end combat power idle in the Zerg territory.

【At this point, I hope readers will remember our domain name Taiwan Novel Network →𝖙𝖜𝖐𝖆𝖓.𝖈𝖔𝖒】

Wu Qing discussed with the Queen Zerg that with the overall strength of the Zerg greatly increased, it was time to explore the mysterious underground world.

With the protection of the underground world barrier, the Zerg entered the underground world and fought if they could, and ran if they couldn't, advancing and retreating at their own will.

With this decision, Wu Qing found a reason to be alone just after the Zerg army supporting the Naga tribe set out, and took back his consciousness from the Zerg clone.

The Zerg territory, led by two three-star hosts No. 1 and No. 2, accompanied by four queens, led 5,000 flying dragons, 100 hydralisks, 100 stealth spiders and 100 explosive mosquitoes, a total of more than 30,000 Zerg troops, through the tall and spacious underground passage, came to the large platform at the edge of the underground world.

Wu Qing did not send Zerg puppies to fight this time because a large number of Zerg puppies were sent out. A small number of Zerg puppies are not very useful in front of powerful Zerg troops.

This time entering the underground world is mainly a test. Zerg puppies are not needed to fight with the creatures in the underground world. The main force is 5,000 dragons.

If it feels that there is an advantage to be gained, only hydralisks will go down, and 100 stealth spiders and 100 explosive mosquitoes will follow. They are just testing the combat power and are not the main combat force.

No. 1 and No. 2, two three-star hosts and four queens are the high-end combat power of the Zerg. When encountering powerful creatures in the underground world, they are needed to deal with them.

Wu Qing possessed the three-star host No. 1 and observed the situation in the underground world.

The underground world is still the same as when I first saw it. The light is very dark. Only by relying on the perspective of the three-star host can I see the situation in the distance.

Under the platform, it is still a busy ghoul territory. From time to time, new ghouls crawl out of the pools of bones and blood.

In the core area of the ghoul territory in the distance, Wu Qing sensed some dangerous auras, indicating that there were strong people in the ghoul clan.

The Zerg has a three-star host and a three-star queen, which is enough to deal with general dangers. If they really encounter a ruthless person, only the queen can take action.

After observing the situation clearly and formulating a simple battle plan, 5,000 Zerg flying dragons, accompanied by the three-star host and the queen, flew into the underground world through the underground world barrier.

The space in the underground world is very high. The flying dragon tried to fly up, but it couldn't reach the top for a while.

The ghoul clan below noticed something unusual when the flying dragon entered the underground world. Countless ghouls stopped their work and looked up.

The Zerg flying dragons were not polite and launched an attack directly, spraying biological bombs at the densely populated areas of ghouls.

Five thousand batches of biological bombs were continuously fired into the territory of the ghouls in the underground world, blowing the densely packed ghouls into countless white lights, which disappeared one after another.

The surviving ghouls were corroded by the Zerg biological decomposition fluid, from minor injuries to serious injuries, and from serious injuries to death.

Tens of thousands of biological bombs sprayed by Zerg dragons suddenly turned the ghoul territory near the underground world barrier area upside down.

Many biological bombs also fell into the pool of bones and blood where the ghouls were born, blasting the blood and water in it everywhere, exposing countless biological corpses and ghoul eggs.

The underground world ghoul territory was suddenly attacked from the air and was caught off guard. When they reacted, the giant ghouls distributed throughout the territory began to spray corrosive mucus at the flying dragons in the air.

Although the amount of corrosive mucus sprayed by the giant ghouls was large, the flying speed was not fast, and the range to the air was not enough.

The fast and flexible Zerg flying dragons can easily avoid such attacks.

Being attacked is always unpleasant. The flying dragons in the air attacked the exposed giant ghouls, blowing up the giant ghouls that looked like corrosive mucus storage tanks.

The threat to the air was eliminated, and no attack that could effectively damage the Zerg flying dragons was found for the time being. The Zerg flying dragons began to bomb recklessly over the ghoul territory, accurately shooting biological bombs into the ghoul group and the pools of blood.

The ghouls, who had no power to resist, suffered huge losses in a short period of time.

Facing this kind of enemy, five special ghouls quickly rushed from the core area of the distant ghoul territory.

They look like ordinary ghouls, except that their heads are particularly large.

As they approach, Wu Qing feels that danger is approaching quickly.

The Queen of Insects has a more acute perception. It tells Wu Qing that the person coming is a strong person in terms of spiritual power. The Zerg are not afraid and there is no need to worry.

Wu Qing's danger warning is based on his body. An overly powerful spiritual attack can hurt his body.

The Queen of Insects' perception is not wrong. The five big-headed ghouls are floating very fast near the Zerg flying dragons, and a terrifying spiritual storm explodes in the Zerg flying dragon group!

This terrible attack, which is enough to instantly annihilate the souls of ordinary creatures, falls on the Zerg, like a breeze blowing, without causing any waves.

Even if the Zerg with weak spiritual power is protected by the Queen of Insects, a super spiritual energy body, any spiritual attack will have no effect on them.

The Zerg dragons responded to the big-headed ghouls with some biological bombs. Although the mental power could not harm the Zerg dragons, it could prevent the explosion damage of the biological bombs.

Covered by several invisible mental power shields, the Zerg dragons had no way to deal with the big-headed ghouls.

The big-headed ghouls seemed to be the wisest among the ghouls, somewhat similar to the Zerg hosts, with powerful mental power, but they could not even use a small fireball.

Their only means of attack was the mental storm attack.

After the powerful mental storm attack was ineffective, they could only stare blankly, unable to deal with the Zerg dragons flying in the air.

There was no threat at all, and the Zerg dragons let themselves go, bombing along the area where the corpse ghosts were dense, and the surrounding skeleton blood pools were also bombed by them.

But the total number of Zerg dragons is limited, and the continuous attack time is also limited. The endless ghoul territory, let them attack, and the number of ghouls that can be killed in the end is also limited.

This is a great opportunity, and it must not be wasted. The ghouls have no means to deal with the flying dragons now, but that doesn't mean they won't have them in the future. The Zerg must seize this opportunity and make a fortune first.

Under Wu Qing's command, the Hydralisk entered the underground world from the platform that had been leveled long ago.

In order to facilitate the return of the ground troops from the underground world, Wu Qing sent Zerg worker bees to level the edge of the platform and make it a slope that can be easily climbed and descended.

The Zerg Hydralisk entered the underground world and attacked the nearby ghouls.

Like the Zerg puppies, the Hydralisks, which have been fully enhanced twice, have greatly improved their attack range, attack power, attack speed, action speed and defense capabilities.

When such a large number of Zerg Hydralisks attack, the Queen will formulate the best attack plan for them. Some will spray armor-piercing spikes, and some will spray Zerg biodegradable liquid. They will cooperate with each other to kill the enemy more efficiently.

In the face of the mixed attack of the enhanced Hydralisk, the ghouls are simply vulnerable, and the ghouls near the platform were quickly cleared.

100 stealth spiders followed, burrowed into the ground, and mixed in with the hydralisks.

The ghouls were unable to do anything to the Zerg flying dragons in the air, and were feeling frustrated. Now they found that there were enemies attacking from the ground, which was a perfect outlet for them. A large number of ghouls rushed to the edge of the Zerg hydralisks from all directions.

This was exactly what the Zerg wanted. If the ghouls didn't rush over, the killing efficiency would not be improved. It was not appropriate to let the hydralisks look for enemies everywhere.

The Zerg hydralisks opened fire at full power and launched a fierce attack on the ghouls that rushed up.

More and more ghouls rushed up, and more and more hydralisks sprayed Zerg biodegradation fluid. The biodegradation fluid fell like rain, and they didn't care about the number of ghouls that rushed up.

The 100 stealth spiders that had not played a role could only keep moving forward until they were a distance away from the hydralisk formation, and finally reached the enemy's position and quickly burrowed into the ground.

The ghouls, which were being attacked by the Zerg biodegradation liquid and Zerg armor-piercing spikes, were also attacked by the ground spikes from the ground. The thick ground spikes could easily penetrate the ghouls' bodies.

This was equivalent to moving the Zerg's defensive buildings and defensive ground spikes to the front line of the battlefield, and there were still 100 of them at a time.

A large number of ghouls kept rushing up, and they simply couldn't break through the defense line built by the hydralisks and stealth spiders, and they all disappeared in light.

The efficiency of killing enemies here has exceeded the efficiency of the Zerg dragons' bombardment, but the number of dragons is still a little less.

The battle here attracted the five ghoul wise men, who quickly ran over and released mental storms on the Zerg hydralisks, but finally found that their mental storms had no effect on the enemies this time.
